en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik Bin Atiyya, from Dawood Bin Farqad who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who buys an unaware slave girl (not an adult), and she does not menstruate with him until six months pass by for that, and there is no pregnancy with her. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was such that the likes of her do tend to menstruate, and that does not happen to be due to old age, so that is a fault. You can repudiate from it (they acquisition)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Malik ibn ‘Atiyyah from Dawud ibn Farqad who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who buys a slave-girl who possesses awareness but does not experience Hayd (menses) while in his possession until six months and she is not pregnant. He (the Imam) said, ‘If slave-girls similar to her experience Hayd (menses) and it is not because of old age, it is a defect and a reason to revoke the contract of sale?”
